_about: Alexis Muston (1810-1888), Waldensian pastor and historian: The Israel of the Alps, a complete history of the Waldenses and their colonies, translated by John Montgomery, with a documentary appendix by the translator (Glasgow, Edinburgh and London: Blackie, 1875, 2 vols). Volume numbers read off each title page.
